doc: Orbit's starting SYSTEM GRAPH vocabulary (ADR 0033): the kinds of node and the relations a backend's graph is described with, each meaning what its ROLE in src/topology/vocab.mjs says. A starting vocabulary, never an ontology: an organisation adds or narrows names in <storeBase>/organization/topology/vocabulary/*.json and a project in <store>/topology/vocabulary/*.json; a name nobody declares is still recorded, shown and kept, and derives nothing. Names only -- no product, framework or vendor; test/topology-vocabulary.test.mjs holds every row to a known role.
